editorial:
You meet Terri, a busy mom in Atlanta whose normal evening turns scary when Colin, an escaped convict with charm, appears at her door after dark. What starts as a small favor becomes a tense home-invasion thriller. The movie keeps you watching because the danger feels close and personal, with Terri trying to protect her kids while Colin plays mind games. It has a dark, suspenseful vibe and moves quickly once the threat is inside.

The acting is the big draw, especially the two leads, who make the fear and tension feel real. The pacing is brisk, with enough twists to keep you really hooked, though some moments are predictable and the story can feel familiar. If you like tense thrillers with strong performances, this is a very solid pick. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, renting on Apple TV, or on 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Terri fights back and kills Colin, saving her children from the home invasion. She then confronts her husband Jeffrey when he returns home, revealing she knows about his affair with Alexis, Colin's ex-girlfriend. Instead of forgiving him, Terri takes the kids and leaves, ending the nightmare on her own terms and starting over with her kids.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tense home-invasion thrillers with strong lead performances.
